description: This file defines custom exception classes and related error handling structures for FastAPI, including HTTP and WebSocket exceptions, validation errors, and internal error classes.

classes.name: EndpointContext
classes.description: TypedDict for endpoint context information such as function, path, file, and line.

classes.name: HTTPException
classes.description: Custom HTTP exception class extending Starlette's HTTPException, used for client errors.

classes.name: WebSocketException
classes.description: Custom WebSocket exception class extending Starlette's WebSocketException, used for WebSocket errors.

classes.name: RequestErrorModel
classes.description: Pydantic model for request errors, created dynamically.

classes.name: WebSocketErrorModel
classes.description: Pydantic model for WebSocket errors, created dynamically.

classes.name: DependencyScopeError
classes.description: Error indicating invalid dependency scope in FastAPI.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: Base class for validation errors, capturing error details and endpoint context.

classes.name: RequestValidationError
classes.description: Validation error for request data, extends ValidationException.

classes.name: WebSocketRequestValidationError
classes.description: Validation error for WebSocket requests, extends ValidationException.

classes.name: ResponseValidationError
classes.description: Validation error for responses, extends ValidationException.

classes.name: PydanticV1NotSupportedError
classes.description: Error indicating usage of unsupported pydantic v1 models.

classes.name: FastAPIDeprecationWarning
classes.description: Custom warning class for deprecation notices in FastAPI.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructors for various exception classes, initializing error details and context.

methods.name: errors
methods.description: Returns the list of validation errors.

methods.name: _format_endpoint_context
methods.description: Formats endpoint context information for error messages.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: String representation of validation exceptions, including error details and endpoint context.
